The moment the box opens, it feels regal. The “Apna Tohfa” tag on the front adds a heartfelt, personal touch. It makes a perfect gift for family, friends, relatives, and office colleagues.

Each jar is airtight, so the dry fruits stay fresh and crunchy for weeks. Once the gifting is done, the box can also be kept for home décor or storage.
